run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:20:39Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: Frontend's RequestErrorRate alert coincides with chaos fault injection against its checkout dependency. In 2026-11-18T00:20:39Z-01:38:40Z the frontend span metrics moved from 0 error spans (0 at the 01:20:00 evaluation of a 30-minute window) to 1701.0 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases, and those error spans are confined to the checkout path: POST /api/checkout 418.15, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 418.15, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 418.15, plus 28.42 tcp.connect errors, while GET/POST /api/cart, /api/data, GetAds, AddItem and GetCart stayed at 0. Errors first appear at the 01:20:39 sample, peak at 227.78 (01:25:59) and are still 70.67 at the 01:34:39 sample. The only unready workload in the namespace is checkout: pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is Running but Ready=False (ContainersNotReady), restartCount 11, container waiting in CrashLoopBackOff with last termination reason Error, exit code 2 at 01:26:32; the checkout Deployment is the only one of 21 with no ready/available replicas, and the checkout Service Endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses for that pod. Kubernetes events show Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning a PodChaos object every minute from 01:19:32 to 01:28:32, each recording 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' then 'Successfully recover chaos' ~55s later, while the kubelet logged 7 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (Killing) events from 01:19:32 and 6 pulls of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest from 01:19:32 to 01:25:59. The most supported explanation (hypothesis, since the chaos specs could not be read) is that these experiments repeatedly restarted/replaced the checkout container, leaving the single checkout replica unable to serve, so frontend's PlaceOrder calls failed and its /api/checkout route returned errors, firing the alert; frontend-proxy shows its own matching error spans (ingress 437.43, router frontend egress 420.18). At 01:13:32-01:13:35, before the chaos began, frontend checkout calls were succeeding (http.status_code 200, rpc.grpc.status_code 0). The conclusion is partial because the PodChaos/Schedule resource specs could not be read, Jaeger data stops at 01:13:35 (before onset), and no application log explains the exit code 2.

claims.text: In the window 00:20:39Z-01:38:40Z the frontend service span metric shows 1701.01 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases versus 103008.84 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so the frontend was recording error-status spans.

Frontend error spans are concentrated on the checkout path: span_name POST 418.15, POST /api/checkout 418.15, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 418.15, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 418.15 and tcp.connect 28.42, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart', /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and GetCart are 0.

Frontend error spans were absent before the alert: the 1800s increase of frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans was 0 at the 01:20:00Z evaluation (covering 00:50:00Z-01:20:00Z) and 1511.19 at the 01:30:00Z evaluation; the 300s series first becomes non-zero at the 01:20:39Z sample (16.67), peaks at 227.78 at 01:25:59Z and is 70.67 at the 01:34:39Z sample.

Before the error onset, sampled frontend traces at 01:13:32-01:13:35Z show POST /api/checkout completing with http.status_code 200 and its child grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (started 00:42:50Z) is Running but not ready: Ready and ContainersReady False with reason ContainersNotReady since 01:26:32Z, container checkout ready=false with restartCount 11, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout', and lastState terminated reason Error exitCode 2 startedAt 01:26:27Z finishedAt 01:26:32Z.

Of the 21 otel-demo Deployments, checkout is the only one with no ready/available replicas (replicas 1, readyReplicas null, availableReplicas null); the other 20 including product-catalog, cart, payment, currency, shipping, quote, email, ad, recommendation and fraud-detection each show ready=1 available=1.

Kubelet events on pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q record 7 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (Killing) events from 01:19:32Z to 01:22:32Z, 6 pulls of image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest from 01:19:32Z to 01:25:59Z, and 26 BackOff events 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' from 01:21:32Z to 01:27:20Z.

The checkout Service Endpoints hold only notReadyAddresses (ip 100.96.4.26, targetRef pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, port tcp-service 8080) and no ready addresses, whereas frontend and frontend-proxy endpoints have ready addresses.
Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay in namespace chaos-mesh (source schedule-cron) emitted Spawned events creating a new object every minute from 01:19:32Z through 01:28:32Z.

Each spawned PodChaos object (names otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-zv9mn, -927gn, -d2m7w, -dc4vz, -jgn2n, -ktl9k, -vxxwz, -6cwbh, -qgddz, -gl228) recorded 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' at 01:19:32Z-01:28:32Z and 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' about 55s later, i.e. ten apply/recover cycles between 01:19:32Z and 01:29:27Z.
frontend-proxy recorded its own error spans in the window: span_name 'ingress' 437.43 and 'router frontend egress' 420.18 STATUS_CODE_ERROR increases.

Checkout's own spans carry no error status in this window: checkout span increases are all STATUS_CODE_UNSET (HTTP POST 2776.84, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 925.61, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 925.61, etc.), and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for checkout.

tcp.connect error spans in the window belong to frontend (28.42) and payment (0); product-catalog shows an increase of 23683.28 spans only under STATUS_CODE_UNSET with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series returned, and cart (34153.25) and email (3726.81) likewise returned only UNSET series.

Small error-span trickles in ad (3.05), fraud-detection (3.05) and recommendation (3.04) increases were already present before the frontend errors began, e.g. a constant 1.05 per 600s in the 01:10:39Z and 01:15:39Z samples, and recommendation already showed 1.05 at the 01:05:39Z sample.

The PodChaos experiments spawned by Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay repeatedly killed/replaced the checkout container (kubelet 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' plus pause:latest image pulls), leaving the only checkout replica not ready and without a ready Service endpoint, so frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls failed (including 28 tcp.connect errors) and its POST /api/checkout route produced the error spans that fired RequestErrorRate.

frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' error spans represent the same failing /api/checkout responses of frontend reaching the proxy; this is unverified because no error trace or proxy log was observed.

The Schedule name 'otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay' points at product-catalog while its spawned experiments were recorded against pod otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, so the experiment appears mis-targeted or mislabelled relative to its name; the actual action/selector cannot be confirmed because the chaos resources are not readable with the available tools.

product-catalog itself shows no failure signal: its Deployment reports ready=1 available=1, and its span metrics returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series (23683.28) with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series in the window.

The frontend checkout path was healthy before the chaos window: sampled traces at 01:13:32-01:13:35Z show POST /api/checkout with http.status_code 200 and PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and error-span increases were 0 up to the 01:20:00Z evaluation.

Rejected: a defect inside frontend caused the error-rate alert. Frontend error spans are limited to the checkout call path (POST /api/checkout, its api route span and the PlaceOrder client span, plus tcp.connect) while other frontend routes (/api/cart, /api/data, /api/products, /api/recommendations) show 0 error spans, and the checkout Service has no ready endpoint during the error period.

Rejected as the observed cause: a product-catalog network delay. Despite the chaos object name, the applied-target records name pod otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, and product-catalog shows a ready deployment and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series in the window.

Read the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and its spawned PodChaos objects to confirm the action (e.g. pod-failure vs container-kill), the selector, the duration and whether the selector or name is mis-configured so that checkout is targeted instead of product-catalog.

Check whether the Schedule is still active and whether pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q recovers to Ready, since the last observed apply was 01:28:32Z and the pod was still in CrashLoopBackOff with no ready endpoint at query time.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh Schedule and PodChaos resources could not be read (those kinds are not in the allowed Kubernetes resource list), so the declared action, selector, duration, creation/modification time and current state of the fault injection are unknown; only events and pause-image/container-restart symptoms were observed.

Jaeger trace data in this target ends at 01:13:35Z (source_end_at of the trace sample), i.e. before the 01:20 error onset, so no error trace, error detail text or span-level status of the failing checkout calls was available.

fetch_pod_logs returned no log lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, and checkout's current-instance log lines end at 01:05:41Z with the previous instance unavailable, so the cause of the checkout container's exit code 2 at 01:26:32Z was not read.
list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no rule, so the alert's expression, threshold and the meaning of the annotation value 3.5 could not be verified.

The checkout container restart history before 01:19:32Z is unknown: restartCount is 11 but only 7 'definition changed' Killing events were observed inside the events window, so earlier restarts (and whether they affected requests) are not established.
The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so who or what created/modified the chaos Schedule cannot be established.
Whether the frontend error rate has fully returned to zero after the 01:34:39Z sample is unknown because the query window ends at 01:38:40Z and the last sampled value is still non-zero (70.67).
next_steps: Human review of the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay spec (selector, action, duration, schedule) and of the ten spawned PodChaos objects to confirm what fault was applied to checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q and whether the target/name mismatch is intentional.

Collect checkout container previous-instance logs or node-level container logs covering 01:19-01:27Z to explain exit code 2, and confirm whether the pod becomes Ready after the last chaos recovery at ~01:29:27Z.
Verify the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition in the Prometheus rule files to confirm the threshold and the units of the reported value 3.5.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
